LESSON: INDIGENOUS KENYAN CRAFT- POTTERY

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: CREATIVE ARTS
Strand: Performing and Displaying
Topic 2.4: Indigenous Kenyan Craft- Pottery

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Indigenous Kenyan Craft- Pottery. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why are clay items dried under the shade?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify pottery items made using slab technique
2. model a vase using slab technique for expression
3. appreciate pottery as an indigenous Kenyan craft

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: INDIGENOUS KENYAN CRAFT- POTTERY
This lesson teaches Indigenous Kenyan Craft- Pottery for Grade 6 CREATIVE ARTS.

STUDY STEPS
1. identify pottery items made using slab technique
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. model a vase using slab technique for expression
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. appreciate pottery as an indigenous Kenyan craft
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Indigenous Kenyan Craft- Pottery using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Indigenous Kenyan Craft- Pottery above.
2. Explain Indigenous Kenyan Craft- Pottery to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Indigenous Kenyan Craft- Pottery.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Indigenous Kenyan Craft- Pottery with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Indigenous Kenyan Craft- Pottery important for a Grade 6 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why are clay items dried under the shade?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify pottery items made using slab technique
2. model a vase using slab technique for expression
3. appreciate pottery as an indigenous Kenyan craft

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
